exposure: Lead nitrate in drinking water (0, 0.5, and 1%)
outcome: Developmental abnormalities (eyes, ear, limbs, neck, ventral abdominal wall)
Degenerative changes in granule and Purkinje cells
Apoptosis of neurons (increase in Bax and caspase 3, decrease in Bcl-2)
cohort: Female Sprague-Dawley rats were given lead nitrate for two weeks before conception and during pregnancy.
finding: Gestational lead exposure in rats induces fetal toxicity, various developmental abnormalities, impairs cerebellar layer development, and causes structural changes and apoptosis in the fetal cerebellar cortex.
cross-section timing: Fetuses were collected on gestational day 21
birth_weight: Reduced body growth and reduced brain weight were observed in fetuses.
gest_age: Fetuses were collected on gestational day 21.
